text:
Maya Chen: heads-up — we just saw a bunch of late-arrival telemetry for the 03/20 22:00-00:00 window. dashboard shows a gap then a spike of duplicate-ish events.
Devin Patel: saw it too. looks like consumer lag + retry flood from eu-ingest for that hour.
Ara Gomez: logs show repeated attempts with slightly different payload_id. possible partial rehydration from upstream connector. snippet: ```WARN consumer: retrying event id=evt_9b2a payload_id=abc1234 status=409```
Maya Chen: TL;DR: we need a short plan: 1) whether to run a targeted backfill, 2) which routing lane (priority vs low-priority backfill), 3) console preflight UX (cost estimate + dedupe toggle).
Leila Park: +1 on a preflight cost estimate. last time an on-demand recompute doubled our daily egress cost. can we show token estimate + expected runtime?
Devin Patel: we already have the small estimator in replayer API (`/v1/replay/estimate`) but it assumes idempotent joins. if payload_id varies we risk duplicates unless we dedupe at join-key. API needs an option: `dedupe_by: payload_id | event_id | none`
Ara Gomez: ops question: if we run on high-priority lane it will preempt other backfills and bump latency for critical aggregates. should default to low-priority and allow escalation with explicit `force=true` from console.
Samir (ops-bot): incident-note: created incident INC-2026-081, tagging ingesters & platform.
Constance: console UX idea: when user clicks "Run backfill" show a modal that: - shows the estimator - suggests `dedupe_by` based on schema heuristics - shows routing lane radio (low / standard / force-high) - warns if SLA-impacting.
Maya Chen: decision proposal: default to low-priority lane; require an explicit checkbox "allow preemption" to use standard/high; default dedupe_by to `payload_id` when available, else `event_id` if stable. also enable dry-run toggle.
Devin Patel: sounds safe. we should also add a server-side guard: if estimated cost > $X or runtime > 6h, require engineer review (post to #eng-platform for approval) before hitting high-priority.
Leila Park: agree. also add a short-lived routing key `backfill:high-temp` that expires so we don't accidentally leave high-priority forever.
Ara Gomez: one API nit: adding `dedupe_by` param changes canonical contract. let's keep it optional and have server fallback. we should add a compatibility layer in the replay API that ignores unknown fields, and document it in the internal API spec.
Constance: I'll mock the modal in figma and add text for the preflight warnings. will include a small link to the estimator docs.
Maya Chen: operational steps: 1) Devin to add `dedupe_by` + `estimate` improvements in replayer API PR (small) 2) Ara to add routing key `backfill:high-temp` + preemption guard in routing service 3) Constance + UX to ship console modal and wire the `dry-run` + `force` toggles 4) Leila to add dashboard alert that surfaces when a backfill with `force=true` runs 
Devin Patel: I'll aim for a PR today for the estimator tweak and add a simple `--dedupe-by` flag for the CLI runner.
Ara Gomez: routing change: I'll add a TTL to the `backfill:high-temp` token (default 24h) and a control-plane metric `backfill.priority.escalations` so we can graph it.
Samir (ops-bot): note: reminder to run a replay smoke on staging first.
Maya Chen: one more: add a small postmortem checklist entry so we can capture whether dedupe prevented duplicates or not (prompt: was dedupe_by available? which field matched?).
Leila Park: +1. also add a console banner for customers during major rehydrates: "You can run a targeted backfill; this may affect live SLAs — see details."
Constance: OK I'll start the mock and open a UX PR, pinging @Maya and @Devin for review.
Maya Chen: thanks all. summary action items in thread below and I'll open a ticket to track the approval gate. :thumbsup:
